questions.question: What must a timeout handler do beyond recording a timeout status?
options: Leave the child running so it might finish later
Terminate or kill as required, then wait for the actual child to exit
questions.explanation: The supervisor must resolve the actual process lifetime. A status label does not stop computation or release process resources.
optionFeedback: A timed-out parent can leave the child consuming resources. Terminate the process group, escalate if needed and reap its exit.
The supervisor must resolve the actual process lifetime. A status label does not stop computation or release process resources.
Editing a log does not stop a process. Check process termination and the resulting exit status.
